prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic high-end lounge mirror selfie with red and purple neon light.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult fashion-forward woman with sleek wet-look hair, evening glam makeup, natural luminous skin, and a confident smile, wearing an opaque black silk knee-length dress with secure straps and understated gold jewelry.
prompt.composition_elements: Side-angle mirror selfie with a natural stance beside a luxury marble countertop, smartphone in hand, gold-framed mirror with subtle smudges, perfume bottles, and a generic red-purple neon sign reflection without readable branding.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Red neon ambient light plus direct phone flash, flash starburst on mirror, deep cinematic shadows, realistic silk and jewelry sparkle, expensive late-night mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 vertical smartphone capture, slightly grainy, high contrast, sharp silk and jewelry texture, realistic subsurface skin response, natural reflection.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A photorealistic 9:16 high-end lounge mirror selfie of an approved adult fashion-forward woman with sleek wet-look hair, evening glam makeup, natural luminous skin, and a confident smile. She wears an opaque black silk knee-length dress with secure straps and understated gold jewelry, standing naturally beside a luxury marble countertop while holding a modern smartphone. Include a gold-framed mirror with subtle smudges, perfume bottles, and a generic red-purple neon reflection with no readable branding. Use red neon ambient light plus direct phone flash, a flash starburst on the mirror, deep cinematic shadows, realistic silk texture and jewelry sparkle, slight grain, and an expensive confident night-out mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, backless mini dress, thin straps, exposed back, cleavage emphasis, lip biting, twisting body to emphasize curves, sexualized pose, nudity, readable luxury branding, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, lounge, gold mirror, marble, red-purple light, flash, silk mood, and jewelry; replace sign text with generic non-readable neon and use opaque wardrobe. Do not reproduce luxury logos or typography.

changes: Replaced backless mini dress, thin-strapped exposure, cleavage emphasis, lip biting, body-emphasis twist, and luxury branding with opaque fashion, natural stance, and generic neon.
